title: kefersteinia forcipata
intro: Kefersteinia forcipata, commonly known as the orchid tree, is a plant species that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Kefersteinia forcipata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
